"#!/usr/bin/env bash
# pre-push: checks clean working tree, evidence freshness, and runs L2 gate before push
set -e

if [ ! -d \"node_modules\" ]; then
  echo \"Skipping pre-push: node_modules not installed. Run npm install.\"
  exit 0
fi

# Assert Node version matches .nvmrc (INV-53)
if [ -f \".nvmrc\" ]; then
  NVMRC_MAJOR=$(cut -d. -f1 .nvmrc)
  RUNTIME_MAJOR=$(node -e \"process.stdout.write(process.version.slice(1).split('.')[0])\")
  if [ \"$RUNTIME_MAJOR\" != \"$NVMRC_MAJOR\" ]; then
    echo \"Error: Node major mismatch — runtime v${RUNTIME_MAJOR}.x, .nvmrc requires v${NVMRC_MAJOR}.x. Run: nvm use\"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# Unset git hook env vars so integration tests can create and operate on
# independent temp repositories without GIT_DIR poisoning their git calls.
unset GIT_DIR GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_COMMON_DIR

# Bind the gate to the commit(s) Git will actually push. A single checkout can
# qualify only one commit; different pushed commits need separate qualified runs.
PUSH_SUBJECT_SHA=\"\"
while read -r _local_ref local_sha _remote_ref _remote_sha; do
  [ -z \"$local_sha\" ] && continue
  [[ \"$local_sha\" =~ ^0+$ ]] && continue
  if ! pushed_commit=$(git rev-parse --verify \"$local_sha^{commit}\" 2>/dev/null); then
    echo \"Error: pushed object is not a commit and cannot be qualified by the pre-push gate.\"
    exit 1
  fi
  if [ -n \"$PUSH_SUBJECT_SHA\" ] && [ \"$PUSH_SUBJECT_SHA\" != \"$pushed_commit\" ]; then
    echo \"Error: one pre-push gate cannot qualify multiple commits; push them separately.\"
    exit 1
  fi
  PUSH_SUBJECT_SHA=\"$pushed_commit\"
done

push_subject_matches_head() {
  [ -z \"$PUSH_SUBJECT_SHA\" ] || [ \"$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)\" = \"$PUSH_SUBJECT_SHA\" ]
}

if ! push_subject_matches_head; then
  echo \"Error: pushed commit does not match HEAD; check out and qualify the commit being pushed.\"
  exit 1
fi

if [ -n \"$(git status --porcelain | grep -v '^??')\" ]; then
  echo \"Error: working tree has uncommitted changes. Commit or stash before pushing.\"
  exit 1
fi

# ─── arbiter pre-push evidence-freshness gate (Port #4) ──────────────────────
# Reject pushes whose .arbiter/evidence/ is older than the budget. Bypassable
# via ARBITER_PREPUSH_BYPASS=true (exact match — loudly logged). Soften to
# warn-only when the staged diff is docs-only or low-risk.
#
# Env contract:
#   ARBITER_PREPUSH_MAX_AGE_MIN   integer minutes (default 240 = 4 h)
#   ARBITER_PREPUSH_BYPASS        exact string 'true' bypasses; other truthy
#                                 values warn and the gate still runs
#   ARBITER_PREPUSH_BYPASS_REASON free-form string, recorded in bypass log
#   ARBITER_PREPUSH_SKIP          exact string 'true' skips the freshness gate
#                                 entirely (for nested hook invocations + tests)
#
# Notes:
#   - Runs BEFORE the rsync/worktree branch so it sees the real evidence dir.
#   - 'find' empty result ⇒ no evidence yet ⇒ silently skip (do not block
#     first-time pushers).
ARBITER_PREPUSH_EVIDENCE_DIR=\"${ARBITER_PREPUSH_EVIDENCE_DIR:-.arbiter/evidence}\"
ARBITER_PREPUSH_MAX_AGE_MIN=\"${ARBITER_PREPUSH_MAX_AGE_MIN:-240}\"

if [ \"${ARBITER_PREPUSH_SKIP:-}\" = \"true\" ]; then
  : # explicit skip — no warning; used by nested hook recursion
elif [ -d \"$ARBITER_PREPUSH_EVIDENCE_DIR\" ]; then
  # newest mtime in seconds-since-epoch under the evidence dir (find ignores empty trees).
  # bypass-log.jsonl is excluded so a successful bypass doesn't self-reset the freshness
  # window on the next push.
  NEWEST_EPOCH=$(find \"$ARBITER_PREPUSH_EVIDENCE_DIR\" -type f \\
    -not -name 'bypass-log.jsonl' \\
    -printf '%T@\\n' 2>/dev/null \\
    | sort -nr | head -n1 | cut -d. -f1)

  if [ -z \"$NEWEST_EPOCH\" ]; then
    : # empty evidence tree → treat as missing, skip the gate
  else
    NOW_EPOCH=$(date +%s)
    AGE_MIN=$(( (NOW_EPOCH - NEWEST_EPOCH) / 60 ))

    if [ \"$AGE_MIN\" -gt \"$ARBITER_PREPUSH_MAX_AGE_MIN\" ]; then
      # Stale evidence — decide between hard-fail and warn-only.
      BYPASS_RAW=\"${ARBITER_PREPUSH_BYPASS:-}\"
      BYPASSED=false
      if [ \"$BYPASS_RAW\" = \"true\" ]; then
        # Loud bypass — Port #10 contract (exact 'true' only).
        # Mirrors `scripts/lib/loud-bypass.mjs` semantically in bash; not
        # invoked directly because this hook runs before the rsync block
        # and we want zero non-builtin dependencies on the freshness path.
        BR=\"$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)\"
        TS=\"$(date -u +%FT%TZ)\"
        REASON=\"${ARBITER_PREPUSH_BYPASS_REASON:-unspecified}\"
        echo \"arbiter-bypass env=ARBITER_PREPUSH_BYPASS branch=${BR} at=${TS} reason=\\\"${REASON}\\\"\" >&2
        mkdir -p \"$ARBITER_PREPUSH_EVIDENCE_DIR\"
        BR=\"$BR\" TS=\"$TS\" REASON=\"$REASON\" AGE_MIN=\"$AGE_MIN\" BUDGET=\"$ARBITER_PREPUSH_MAX_AGE_MIN\" \\
          node -e 'const e=process.env;process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({env:\"ARBITER_PREPUSH_BYPASS\",branch:e.BR,ts:e.TS,value:\"true\",bypassed:true,reason:e.REASON,age_min:Number(e.AGE_MIN),budget_min:Number(e.BUDGET)})+\"\\n\")' \\
          >> \"$ARBITER_PREPUSH_EVIDENCE_DIR/bypass-log.jsonl\"
        BYPASSED=true
      elif [ -n \"$BYPASS_RAW\" ]; then
        # Ambiguous value (e.g. '1', 'yes', 'TRUE') — warn, do not bypass.
        echo \"Warning: ARBITER_PREPUSH_BYPASS='${BYPASS_RAW}' is ambiguous; only the exact string 'true' bypasses. Proceeding with gate.\" >&2
      fi

      if [ \"$BYPASSED\" = \"false\" ]; then
        # Classify the change set; if docs-only or non-backend/low-risk, downgrade to warn.
        # Falls back to hard-fail if the classifier cannot determine the diff (fail-closed).
        UPSTREAM=\"$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name '@{u}' 2>/dev/null || echo '')\"
        if [ -z \"$UPSTREAM\" ]; then
          # No upstream ⇒ compare against origin/main if it exists, else skip classification.
          if git rev-parse --verify --quiet origin/main >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            UPSTREAM=\"origin/main\"
          fi
        fi

        DOCS_ONLY=false
        BACKEND_CHANGED=true
        HIGH_RISK=true
        if [ -n \"$UPSTREAM\" ] && [ -x \"$(command -v node)\" ] && [ -f \"scripts/ci-classify-changes.mjs\" ]; then
          CLASSIFY_OUT=$(BASE_SHA=\"$UPSTREAM\" HEAD_SHA=HEAD node scripts/ci-classify-changes.mjs 2>/dev/null || echo '')
          if echo \"$CLASSIFY_OUT\" | grep -q '^  classify: docs_only=true'; then DOCS_ONLY=true; fi
          if echo \"$CLASSIFY_OUT\" | grep -q '^  classify: backend_changed=false'; then BACKEND_CHANGED=false; fi
          if echo \"$CLASSIFY_OUT\" | grep -q '^  classify: high_risk=false'; then HIGH_RISK=false; fi
        fi

        if [ \"$DOCS_ONLY\" = \"true\" ] || { [ \"$BACKEND_CHANGED\" = \"false\" ] && [ \"$HIGH_RISK\" = \"false\" ]; }; then
          echo \"Warning: .arbiter/evidence/ is ${AGE_MIN} min old (budget ${ARBITER_PREPUSH_MAX_AGE_MIN}). Low-risk change set → proceeding.\" >&2
        else
          echo \"Error: .arbiter/evidence/ is ${AGE_MIN} min old (budget ${ARBITER_PREPUSH_MAX_AGE_MIN} min). Re-run the gate to refresh evidence, or set ARBITER_PREPUSH_BYPASS=true with ARBITER_PREPUSH_BYPASS_REASON='…' to force-push.\" >&2
          exit 1
        fi
      fi
    fi
  fi
fi
# ─── end evidence-freshness gate ─────────────────────────────────────────────

# ─── arbiter pre-push chain-batching gate (#2102) ────────────────────────────
# Enforced half of the chain-batching advisory (`is_unbatched`): when
# `.claude/.task/status.json` declares a non-empty `chainIds` (via
# `arbiter task init --chain <id>` / `arbiter ship --chain <id>`), every id in
# [taskId, ...chainIds] must have a commit in the push range before the push
# is allowed. Fails CLOSED only on a genuine missing id — any other condition
# (no status file, empty/absent chainIds, unreadable JSON, no push-range base)
# is a silent no-op so this gate can never block an unrelated push.
# Own push range, unconditional: the secret-scan PUSH_RANGE is computed inside an
# EJS-conditional block, so this gate must derive its own range independently.
if CHAIN_IDS=\"$(node -e '
try {
  const s = JSON.parse(require(\"fs\").readFileSync(\".claude/.task/status.json\", \"utf8\"))
  const c = Array.isArray(s.chainIds) ? s.chainIds : []
  if (c.length === 0) process.exit(0)
  const ids = [s.taskId, ...c].filter(Boolean).map((x) => String(x).replace(/^#/, \"\"))
  process.stdout.write(ids.join(\" \"))
} catch (e) { process.exit(0) }
' 2>/dev/null)\"; then
  : # status read (the one-liner exits 0 on every fail-open path above)
else
  # FAIL-OPEN-INTENT: node unavailable — the chain gate is a silent no-op
  CHAIN_IDS=\"\"
fi

if [ -n \"$CHAIN_IDS\" ]; then
  # #2334 — the BASE range, not the incremental one. This gate asks \"does every chained id
  # have a commit on this branch\", which is a property of the branch, not of one push. With
  # `@{u}..HEAD` preferred, the first push passes and every later push sees only the new
  # commits — so it demands each id be named AGAIN in that increment, which cannot be
  # satisfied. That made the chain feature unusable on any branch pushed more than once.
  # `@{u}..HEAD` remains the fallback for a branch that has no base ref to compare against.
  CHAIN_PUSH_RANGE=\"\"
  if git rev-parse --verify --quiet origin/main >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    CHAIN_PUSH_RANGE=\"origin/main..HEAD\"
  elif git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name '@{u}' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    CHAIN_PUSH_RANGE=\"@{u}..HEAD\"
  fi

  # FAIL-OPEN-INTENT: an unresolvable range must not block an unrelated push — the whole
  # scan (including the hard-fail) only runs when the range log actually succeeds.
  if [ -n \"$CHAIN_PUSH_RANGE\" ] && CHAIN_SUBJECTS=\"$(git log --format=%s \"$CHAIN_PUSH_RANGE\" 2>/dev/null)\"; then
    CHAIN_MISSING=\"\"
    for id in $CHAIN_IDS; do
      printf '%s\\n' \"$CHAIN_SUBJECTS\" | grep -Eq \"#${id}([^0-9]|$)\" || CHAIN_MISSING=\"$CHAIN_MISSING #${id}\"
    done
    if [ -n \"$CHAIN_MISSING\" ]; then
      echo \"Error: chain batching (#2102) — no commit in the push range (${CHAIN_PUSH_RANGE}) references:${CHAIN_MISSING}\" >&2
      echo \"Every id declared via --chain needs a commit naming it, e.g. a commit subject containing \\\"#1234\\\".\" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
  fi
fi
# ─── end chain-batching gate ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

# ─── reuse fresh green gate evidence (skip redundant rerun, #2085) ────────────
# The heavy gate below is otherwise UNCONDITIONAL. If check-all.mjs already
# stamped a GREEN L2 marker (.arbiter/gate-pass.json) that still BINDS this exact
# tree, reuse it and skip the rerun. #2328 moved the decision into the shared
# verifier (scripts/lib/gate-evidence.mjs), so this hook now demands the same
# axes as every other consumer: schema, level, TTL, commit, branch, checkout
# root, toolchain fingerprint and working-tree content hash.
# Fail-closed: a missing verifier / missing / malformed / non-binding stamp, or
# any error at all → fall through and run the full gate exactly as before.
#
# TRUST BOUNDARY: local convenience, NOT a security control. The stamp is a plain
# JSON file a local process could forge; it only gates whether a developer's own
# machine reruns its own gate. CI re-runs the full gate independently and stays
# authoritative regardless — the same trust model the Stop hook already places in
# this same file.
if [ -f \".arbiter/gate-pass.json\" ] && [ -f \"scripts/lib/gate-evidence.mjs\" ]; then
  if REUSE_MSG=$(node scripts/lib/gate-evidence.mjs verify \\
       --min-level L2 --max-age-min \"$ARBITER_PREPUSH_MAX_AGE_MIN\" 2>/dev/null); then
    if ! push_subject_matches_head; then
      echo \"Error: HEAD changed while pre-push evidence was being verified.\"
      exit 1
    fi
    echo \"PRE-PUSH: reusing green $REUSE_MSG, skipping rerun\"
    exit 0
  fi
fi
# ─── end green-evidence reuse ────────────────────────────────────────────────

if ! push_subject_matches_head; then
  echo \"Error: HEAD changed before the pre-push gate started.\"
  exit 1
fi

# ─── one gate per repo, foreground (#2427) ───────────────────────────────────
# Both branches below launch the heavy gate through scripts/lib/gate-mutex.mjs,
# which takes the SAME per-repo flock `arbiter gate-exec` takes. Two pushes (or a
# push and an agent's gate) in one repo therefore serialise instead of trampling
# each other's temp files and starving each other's test workers.
#
# The wrapper runs the gate in THIS process group — no setsid, no `&`, no detach
# — so a Ctrl-C on the push reaches the gate, and a pid-targeted signal is
# forwarded down the descendant tree. The gate additionally watches the pid that
# launched it and aborts between checks if it is gone, which is what covers the
# one signal nothing can forward: SIGKILL. That is the orphan that stamped a
# green marker for a tree it never finished testing.

# Vite/vitest (v5+) cannot handle '#' in the project root path.
# Use pwd -P (physical path) to detect symlink-based worktrees where $PWD
# may not contain '#' even though the real path does.
# Rsync to a '#'-free temp dir and run the gate from there.
ORIG_DIR=\"$(pwd -P)\"
if [[ \"$ORIG_DIR\" == *\"#\"* ]]; then
  TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/arbiter-hook-XXXXXX)
  trap 'rm -rf \"$TMP_DIR\"' EXIT
  rsync -a --exclude .git --exclude node_modules --exclude dist . \"$TMP_DIR/\"
  cp -al \"$ORIG_DIR/node_modules\" \"$TMP_DIR/node_modules\"
  # E2E tests need the compiled dist/ binary; hard-link it if present.
  [ -d \"$ORIG_DIR/dist\" ] && cp -al \"$ORIG_DIR/dist\" \"$TMP_DIR/dist\"
  cd \"$TMP_DIR\"
  # --dir \"$ORIG_DIR\": the mutex key derives from the REAL repo's git-common-dir.
  # Keying it off this rsync'd /tmp copy would mint a fresh key per push — a null
  # mutex that serialises nothing.
  ARBITER_HOOK_GIT_CWD=\"$ORIG_DIR\" node scripts/lib/gate-mutex.mjs run --dir \"$ORIG_DIR\" -- node scripts/check-all.mjs L2 --json \"$ORIG_DIR/.arbiter/gate/local-result.json\"
  if [ -n \"$PUSH_SUBJECT_SHA\" ] && [ \"$(git -C \"$ORIG_DIR\" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)\" != \"$PUSH_SUBJECT_SHA\" ]; then
    echo \"Error: HEAD changed while the pre-push gate ran.\"
    exit 1
  fi
  exit 0
fi

node scripts/lib/gate-mutex.mjs run --dir \"$ORIG_DIR\" -- node scripts/check-all.mjs L2 --json .arbiter/gate/local-result.json
if ! push_subject_matches_head; then
  echo \"Error: HEAD changed while the pre-push gate ran.\"
  exit 1
fi
"
